name: seed-data
description: Seed data as files, for an application, a migration tool or a test fixture to load: per database, the rows every seed gives it (table seeds, and entity and relation seeds through their bindings and mappings) in database terms and foreign key order, as a manifest and one CSV per table, or as one JSON file.

format.description: csv: manifest.json and one CSV per table; json: one seed-data.json per database.
